overview.description: Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve is the first otter conservation reserve in India, located near Hampi in Vijayanagara district in the state of Karnataka. This is a 34 km (21 mi) stretch along Tungabhadra River. The area is well known for smooth-coated otters and soft-shell turtles.

topPlaces.name: Hampi
topPlaces.description: Hampi or Hampe (Kannada: [hɐmpe]), also referred to as the Group of Monuments at Hampi, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in the town of Hampi in Vijayanagara district, east-central Karnataka, India. faq.q: What is the best time to visit Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve?
faq.a: The best time to visit Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve is Nov – Feb. Summers are 26–36°C and winters are 22–32°C.

faq.a: The nearest airport is Tungabhadra Otter Conservation Reserve / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Hubballi Junction (147 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
